messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 29):
"""
These documents are also fully in compliance with the underwriting and rating policy approved by the Board of Directors of the insurer. 4. The statements made in the filing Form IRDAI –HIP are true and correct. Date: Signature of Principal Officer or Designated Officer Place: Name and designation along with Company’s seal Certificate by Product Management Committee (to be issued by PMC and retained by the insurer) 1. This is to certify that: a. The PMC has reviewed the objective of introducing the product, target customers, suitability of the product in the market. b. The product is fully compliant with insurance principles, regulatory requirements. c. The prospectus and sales literature provide all the details based on which the prospect/customer can take an informed decision. d.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who is required to sign the Form IRDAI‑HIP to certify that the product complies with regulatory requirements?","answer":"The Principal Officer or Designated Officer of the insurer must sign the Form IRDAI‑HIP.","facts":["Signature of Principal Officer or Designated Officer","Certificate by Product Management Committee (to be issued by PMC and retained by the insurer)"]},{"question":"What aspects must the Product Management Committee review before issuing a certification for a new health insurance product?","answer":"The PMC must review the product’s objective, target customers, suitability, compliance with insurance principles and regulatory requirements, and ensure prospectus and sales literature provide all necessary details.","facts":["The PMC has reviewed the objective of introducing the product, target customers, suitability of the product in the market","The product is fully compliant with insurance principles, regulatory requirements","The prospectus and sales literature provide all the details based on which the prospect/customer can take an informed decision"]}]}
